verdict.rationale: A probe confirmed that Porkbun serves a live llms.txt (HTTP 200). It also publishes an llms-full.txt and agent-addressed guides, such as an agent-setup page that tells the AI coding agent to do the setup steps itself and a GoDaddy-migration prompt written for an agent. Missing for 10: a markdown variant of the main API documentation (documentation.md returned 404) and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: You are an AI coding agent setting up the Porkbun API for this project. Do these steps yourself.
You are helping someone move domains they own at GoDaddy to Porkbun.
Learn any endpoint's exact response shape with **zero setup** — no key, no account.
